## Loading the model and drawing the names dataset



```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
import numpy as np

pio.templates["watercolor"] = go.layout.Template(layout=dict(
    colorway=["#7fa6d0", "#d9826a", "#a3b06f", "#e0b050",
              "#c98b8b", "#4f8a8b", "#8b6f9c"],
    font=dict(family="Georgia, serif", color="#d8cfc0"),
    paper_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    xaxis=dict(gridcolor="#3a352f", zerolinecolor="#4a443c", linecolor="#d8cfc0"),
    yaxis=dict(gridcolor="#3a352f", zerolinecolor="#4a443c", linecolor="#d8cfc0"),
))
pio.templates.default = "watercolor"

from IPython.display import HTML, display

def show(fig):
    display(HTML(fig.to_html(include_plotlyjs=False, full_html=False, default_height="450px", default_width="100%")))
```

## Analysis

```{python}
#| label: plotly-js
#| echo: false
from plotly.offline import get_plotlyjs

display(HTML(f"<script>{get_plotlyjs()}</script>"))
```

```{python}
#| label: load
ROOT = Path.cwd().parent

data = np.load(ROOT / "data" / "name_activations_gemma-2-9b.npz")
X, y = data["X"], data["y"]
X.shape
```

```{python}
#| label: split
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
idx = rng.permutation(len(y))
split = int(0.8 * len(y))
train, test = idx[:split], idx[split:]

mu, sd = X[train].mean(0), X[train].std(0) + 1e-6
Xs = (X - mu) / sd

def r2_score(p):
    return 1 - ((y[test] - p[test]) ** 2).sum() / ((y[test] - y[test].mean()) ** 2).sum()
```

## Ordinary least squares

```{python}
#| label: ols
w_ols = np.linalg.lstsq(Xs[train], y[train] - y[train].mean(), rcond=None)[0]
pred_ols = Xs @ w_ols + y[train].mean()
r2_ols = r2_score(pred_ols)
r2_ols
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-ols
#| fig-cap: "OLS probe predictions on held-out names"
fig = px.scatter(
    x=y[test], y=pred_ols[test],
    labels={"x": "Black probability (BISG)", "y": "Probe prediction"},
    title=f"Held-out R² = {r2_ols:.2f}",
)
fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=0, y0=0, x1=1, y1=1, line=dict(dash="dash", color="#8a8174"))
show(fig)
```

## Ridge

```{python}
#| label: ridge
# TODO: pick lam by cross-validation within the training set instead of fixing it
lam = 10000.0
A = Xs[train].T @ Xs[train] + lam * np.eye(X.shape[1])
w = np.linalg.solve(A, Xs[train].T @ (y[train] - y[train].mean()))
pred = Xs @ w + y[train].mean()
r2 = r2_score(pred)
r2
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-probe
#| fig-cap: "Ridge probe predictions on held-out names"
fig = px.scatter(
    x=y[test], y=pred[test],
    labels={"x": "Black probability (BISG)", "y": "Probe prediction"},
    title=f"Held-out R² = {r2:.2f}",
)
fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=0, y0=0, x1=1, y1=1, line=dict(dash="dash", color="#8a8174"))
show(fig)
```

## Comparison

```{python}
#| label: comparison
pd.DataFrame({"model": ["ols", "ridge"], "held_out_r2": [r2_ols, r2]})
```
